v2.10.3 (16 September 2026) |feed_title = ‌Pulse Trooper |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v2.9.0|Summer, Exit Stage Left Update]] |next_update = ‌[[v2.11.0|Fall Into Fall Update]] }} __TOC__ ==‌Description== ‌'''v2.10.0''' is the one hundred and fifty-fourth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 11th of September 2026. It is notable for adding in the [[Pulse Trooper]]. This update encompassed four versions, the main v2.10.0 update (released 11 September 2026) and three minor updates, the v2.10.2 (released 11 September 2026), v2.10.1 (released 16 September 2026) and v2.10.3 (released 16 September 2026). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Pulse Trooper]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Fixed [[Enforcer]]'s bullets damaging units. *Fixed [[Warlock]] still being giftable. *Fixed [[Sledger]] still being giftable. :In '''v2.10.1''': *Version number changed from ''v2.10.0'' to ''v2.10.1''. :In '''v2.10.2''': *Fixed client bugs caused by a Roblox update, including most towers breaking their visual effects and attack animations, as well as not taking damage; UI corruption; hangs and game not ending upon reaching zero base health. :In '''v2.10.3''': *Fixed [[Gatling Gun]] being affected more by [[Firerate Buff]]s. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PulseTrooperBanner.png SummerExitStageLeftBanner.png FrostModeReworkBanner.png GladiatorReworkBanner.png EnforcerBanner2.png BeachSkins.png StoryModePI.png UnwaveringTidesThumbnail.png ScubaOpsSkinsThumbnail.png v2.6.0GenericThumbnail4.png v2.6.0GenericThumbnail5.png v2.6.0GenericThumbnail6.png v2.8.0GenericThumbnail1.png v2.8.0GenericThumbnail2.png v2.9.0GenericThumbnail.png v2.9.0GenericThumbnail2.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PulseTrooperUpdateIcon.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown12Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown6Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown5Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown4Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown3Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown2Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown1Hour.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown30Min.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdown15Min.png FallIntoFallUpdateCountdownNow.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v2.10.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|V2.10.0UpdateLog1.png|Pulse Trooper}} {{UpdateH1|Update Log:}} {{UpdateH2|[[Pulse Trooper]]}} {{UpdateGreyText|Introducing [[Pulse Trooper]]!}} {{UpdateWhiteText|[[Pulse Trooper]] is a short-medium range intermediate tower perfect for cutting through dense crowds of enemies. He fires pulses in a circle, and at higher levels, unlocks the ability to fire a beam in a sweeping motion.
Our goal for [[Pulse Trooper]] is to give players a more specialized tower that excels against large, dense crowds.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|V2.10.0UpdateLog1.png}} {{UpdateWhiteText|[[Pulse Trooper]] can be purchased for 3,250 coins.}} {{UpdateRebalance|DefaultPulseTrooperIconIG.png|[[Pulse Trooper]]|{{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Unlock Details|Description = Store Cost: 3,250 Coins Placement Cost: $2,100 Tower Limt: 7 Detection Lead from Level 2 onward}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 0 Stats|Description = Damage: 13 Cooldown: 1.5 Range: 7.5 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: None}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 1: Capacitor Boost|Description = Cost: $700 Damage: 15 Cooldown: 1.2 Range: 7.5 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: None}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 2: Pulse Amplifier|Description = Cost: $3,600 Damage: 25 Cooldown: 1.2 Range: 8.5 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: Lead}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 3: Charged Filament|Description = Cost: $4,900 Damage: 25 Cooldown: 0.55 Range: 8.5 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: Lead}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 4: Sweeper|Description = Cost: $8,500 Damage: 35 Cooldown: 0.55 Range: 9 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: Lead Sweeper Damage: 175 Sweeper Duration: 7.5s Ability Cooldown: 60s Ability Initial Cooldown: 45s}} {{CollapsibleUpgrade|Title = Level 5: Arc Reactor|Description = Cost: $17,000 Damage: 50 Cooldown: 0.55 Range: 10 Max Hits: 1,000 Detection: Lead Sweeper Damage: 300 Sweeper Duration: 6s Ability Cooldown: 60s Ability Initial Cooldown: 45s}}}} {{UpdateH2|Looking Ahead...}} {{UpdateGreyText|Next week, we'll be releasing a handful of skins to welcome the Fall season, alongside a fall themed and decorated lobby.}} }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v2.10.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
